name: Influence
tagline: Study Cialdini's persuasion classic and learn to spot the tricks aimed at you
description: Think through the ideas in Robert Cialdini's Influence with a companion that has read the same book. It works best as a discussion partner: check that you can explain each principle in your own words, trace where it shows up in the wild, and practise spotting the attempts aimed at you. Notes stay yours.
